# ZivaStock - API Architecture

## API Overview

**API Type**: RESTful API  
**Protocol**: HTTPS  
**Data Format**: JSON  
**Authentication**: JWT Bearer Token  
**API Versioning**: URL-based (/api/v1/)  
**Documentation**: OpenAPI/Swagger (auto-generated by FastAPI)  

---

## 1. API Base URL

```
Production: https://api.zivastock.com/api/v1
Staging: https://staging-api.zivastock.com/api/v1
Development: http://localhost:8000/api/v1
```

---

## 2. Authentication & Authorization

### 2.1 Authentication Flow

```
POST /api/v1/auth/login
    ↓
Request: { "email": "user@example.com", "password": "secure_password" }
    ↓
Response: { 
    "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "token_type": "bearer",
    "expires_in": 900
}
    ↓
Subsequent requests include header:
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

### 2.2 Token Refresh

```
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
    ↓
Request: { "refresh_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." }
    ↓
Response: {
    "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9...",
    "token_type": "bearer",
    "expires_in": 900
}
```

### 2.3 Authorization Model

- **Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**
- **Permission Checks**: Middleware validates user permissions before processing requests
- **Resource Ownership**: Users can only access their own data where applicable

---

## 3. API Endpoints

### 3.1 Authentication Endpoints

#### Login
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "secure_password"
}

Response 200:
{
  "access_token": "string",
  "refresh_token": "string",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "role": {
      "id": 1,
      "name": "counter"
    }
  }
}
```

#### Refresh Token
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "refresh_token": "string"
}

Response 200:
{
  "access_token": "string",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "expires_in": 900
}
```

#### Logout
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/logout
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
{
  "message": "Successfully logged out"
}
```

#### Get Current User
```http
GET /api/v1/auth/me
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Doe",
  "role": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "counter",
    "permissions": ["counts.create", "counts.read"]
  },
  "last_login": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
}
```

### 3.2 User Management Endpoints

#### Create User (Admin only)
```http
POST /api/v1/users
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "newuser@example.com",
  "password": "secure_password",
  "first_name": "Jane",
  "last_name": "Smith",
  "role_id": 2
}

Response 201:
{
  "id": 2,
  "email": "newuser@example.com",
  "first_name": "Jane",
  "last_name": "Smith",
  "role_id": 2,
  "is_active": true,
  "created_at": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
}
```

#### List Users
```http
GET /api/v1/users?page=1&limit=20&role=counter&search=john
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "first_name": "John",
      "last_name": "Doe",
      "role": {
        "id": 1,
        "name": "counter"
      },
      "is_active": true,
      "last_login": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 20,
  "pages": 1
}
```

#### Get User by ID
```http
GET /api/v1/users/{user_id}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Doe",
  "role": {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "counter",
    "permissions": ["counts.create", "counts.read"]
  },
  "is_active": true,
  "last_login": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z",
  "created_at": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
}
```

#### Update User
```http
PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Updated",
  "role_id": 3
}

Response 200:
{
  "id": 1,
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Updated",
  "role_id": 3,
  "is_active": true,
  "updated_at": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
}
```

#### Delete User (Admin only)
```http
DELETE /api/v1/users/{user_id}
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
{
  "message": "User deleted successfully"
}
```

### 3.9 Duplicate Detection Endpoints

#### Detect Duplicates
```http
POST /api/v1/duplicates/detect
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "session_id": 1
}

Response 200:
{
  "duplicates_found": 3,
  "message": "Duplicate detection completed"
}
```

#### List Duplicates
```http
GET /api/v1/duplicates?session_id=1&status=pending
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "count_1": {
        "id": 1,
        "product": { "barcode": "1234567890123" },
        "quantity": 50,
        "user": { "first_name": "John" }
      },
      "count_2": {
        "id": 2,
        "product": { "barcode": "1234567890123" },
        "quantity": 55,
        "user": { "first_name": "Jane" }
      },
      "status": "pending",
      "created_at": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "total": 1
}
```

#### Resolve Duplicate
```http
POST /api/v1/duplicates/{duplicate_id}/resolve
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "resolution": "keep_count_1",
  "notes": "Count 1 is more accurate"
}

Response 200:
{
  "id": 1,
  "status": "resolved",
  "resolved_by": 1,
  "resolved_at": "2026-06-09T10:05:00Z"
}
```

```http
  "status": "pending",
  "total_records": 0,
  "uploaded_at": "2026-06-09T10:00:00Z"
}
```

#### Preview Import Data
```http
GET /api/v1/imports/{import_id}/preview
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

{

}
```

```http
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>

Response 200:
```

## 4. WebSocket Endpoints

### 4.1 Real-time Updates

#### Connect to WebSocket
```
ws://localhost:8000/api/v1/ws?token=<access_token>
```

#### Events

**Count Created**
```json
{
  "event": "count.created",
  "data": {
    "count_id": 1,
    "product_id": 1,
    "quantity": 50,
    "user_id": 1,
    "section_id": 1
  }
}
```

**Session Status Changed**
```json
{
  "event": "session.status_changed",
  "data": {
    "session_id": 1,
    "status": "in_progress"
  }
}
```

**Duplicate Detected**
```json
{
  "event": "duplicate.detected",
  "data": {
    "duplicate_id": 1,
    "count_id_1": 1,
    "count_id_2": 2
  }
}
```

**Sync Completed**
```json
{
  "event": "sync.completed",
  "data": {
    "user_id": 1,
    "records_count": 10
  }
}
```

## 5. Error Responses

### 5.1 Standard Error Format
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Invalid input data",
    "details": [
      {
        "field": "email",
        "message": "Invalid email format"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### 5.2 HTTP Status Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 200 | OK |
| 201 | Created |
| 204 | No Content |
| 400 | Bad Request |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 403 | Forbidden |
| 404 | Not Found |
| 409 | Conflict |
| 422 | Validation Error |
| 429 | Too Many Requests |
| 500 | Internal Server Error |

### 5.3 Error Codes

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| VALIDATION_ERROR | Input validation failed |
| AUTHENTICATION_FAILED | Invalid credentials |
| TOKEN_EXPIRED | JWT token expired |
| INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS | User lacks required permission |
| RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND | Requested resource doesn't exist |
| DUPLICATE_RESOURCE | Resource already exists |
| CONFLICT_ERROR | Data conflict detected |
| RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | Too many requests |
| INTERNAL_ERROR | Server error |

---

## 6. Rate Limiting

### 6.1 Rate Limit Rules

| Endpoint | Limit | Window |
|----------|-------|--------|
| POST /auth/login | 5 requests | 15 minutes |
| POST /auth/refresh | 10 requests | 15 minutes |
| POST /counts | 100 requests | 1 minute |
| GET /products | 200 requests | 1 minute |
| POST /sync/push | 50 requests | 1 minute |
| All other endpoints | 100 requests | 1 minute |

### 6.2 Rate Limit Headers

```http
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 95
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1623210000
```

---

## 7. Pagination

### 7.1 Standard Pagination Parameters

```
?page=1&limit=20&sort=created_at&order=desc
```

### 7.2 Pagination Response

```json
{
  "items": [...],
  "total": 100,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 20,
  "pages": 5
}
```

---

## 8. Filtering & Searching

### 8.1 Common Filter Parameters

- `search`: Full-text search
- `status`: Filter by status
- `created_after`: Filter by date range
- `created_before`: Filter by date range
- `sort`: Sort field
- `order`: Sort direction (asc/desc)

### 8.2 Example

```
GET /api/v1/products?search=sample&status=active&sort=description&order=asc
```

---

## 9. API Versioning

### 9.1 Version Strategy

- URL-based versioning: `/api/v1/`
- Backward compatibility maintained for at least 2 major versions
- Deprecation warnings sent in headers

### 9.2 Deprecation Header

```http
X-API-Deprecated: true
X-API-Sunset: 2026-12-31
X-API-Replacement: /api/v2/endpoint
```

---

## 10. Security Headers

```http
Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
X-Frame-Options: DENY
X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'
```
